## What's Changed
* Add `eager` streamed execution to `CodeMode` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/746
* Fix `PlanStore` `get_items` and `set_items` docstrings by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/843
* Add `tool_return_max_chars` to `SummarizingCompaction` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/842
* Drop the unfulfilled 0.28.0 removal date from `SpendStore` deprecations by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/841
* Document the escaped-keys marker format in `step_persistence` docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/840
* Add an async and concurrency guide to `agent_docs`, ported from core by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/835
* Add optional tail-line retention to `Truncate` by @Quiyyy in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/836
* Anchor `Planning` cache breakpoint on the last durable user content by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/833
* Make `FileSystem` content hashes agree across `read_file`, `write_file`, and `edit_file` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/847
* Correct for_run()-built approval-required tool calls to pending in ACP by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/849
* Stop `SnapshotHistorySource.run_history` duplicating messages with serializing stores by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/848
* Floor on released `pydantic-ai` 2.40.0 by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/851
* Emit `DelegationStartEvent` and `DelegationEndEvent` from `SubAgents` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/855
* Fix the `aws-lambda` docs install line, which named a `bedrock` extra that does not exist by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/854
* Offer `pip` and `uv` installation commands throughout the Harness docs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/858
* Give the `CodeMode` sandbox the value shape its own stubs declare by @bohdanhr in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/681

## New Contributors
* @bohdanhr made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/681

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/compare/v0.30.0...v0.31.0

## What's Changed
* Re-export `MCPToolsetClient` from `pydantic_ai_harness.stackone._toolset` so CI lint passes again by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/725
* Frame the `media` docs as Step Persistence plumbing, not a capability by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/751
* Name the internal `Agent` in `SummarizingCompaction`, `ToolOutputLimits`, `SystemReminders`, `Advisor` and `PydanticAIChatModel` so Logfire attributes their runs by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/774
* Shield the cancel+`gather` teardown in `guardrails` parallel mode and `MontyExecutor` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/758
* Add `TrajectoryJudge`: review the live run with a second model on a cadence and steer it mid-run by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/724
* Register TrajectoryJudge in the capability combination policy by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/817
* Deprecate `on_spend`, `on_usage`, `on_fire`, and `PlanEventEmitter` toward capability event subscriptions by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/714
* Emit `FileSystem` traversal events and subscribe `RepoContext` with `@on_event`, deprecating `traversal_tool_names` sniffing by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/712
* Require every capability to decide what OpenTelemetry it emits by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/604
* Require `youdotcom>=3.1.2` and pass attribution kwargs to `You()` so outbound requests carry an `X-Client-Info` header by @tyler5673 in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/786
* Run your own Pydantic AI agent in GitHub Agentic Workflows: the `pydantic-ai` gh-aw engine definition is now hosted here, and `PAI_AGENT` points a workflow at an agent your repository defines by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/708
* Count truncation markers within `Truncate.max_chars` by @Quiyyy in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/816

## New Contributors
* @tyler5673 made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/786
* @Quiyyy made their first contribution in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/816

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/compare/v0.29.1...v0.30.0

## What's Changed
* Make `StepPersistence` replay-safe under durable execution by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/749
* Make `SpendLimits` replay-safe under durable execution by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/748
* Accept inline durable-operation dispatch in the spend composition test by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/766
* Floor on released `pydantic-ai` 2.37.0 and drop the version straddle by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/769
* Propagate a sub-agent's first-party `RunCancelled` past `contain_errors` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/754
* Scrub ambient Logfire credentials in `tests/logfire_variables` so a local `.env` cannot reach the real Logfire API by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/752
* Declare `Advisor`'s default `id` on the class by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/pull/776


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai-harness/compare/v0.28.0...v0.28.1
